en: A monochrome panoramic view over a small town and river valley, seen from an elevated terrace or promenade with a stone-and-wood railing and ornamental flower pots in the foreground. The town with clustered houses and fields stretches across the background. Red printed German captions at the top read the location and viewpoint, and a red handwritten number appears on the right.
